purpose: Do one secondary task without leaving the screen underneath: filter, share, quick add, pick an option, or move around the app.
layout: The parent screen, short and dimmed under a scrim, then one overlay drawn open on top: a bottom sheet with a grabber, a head row (title centred, close on the right) and its controls, ending in the one primary button; or a side drawer from the left.

required: The parent screen's title and a few rows, dimmed under the scrim
A sheet head: grabber, centred title, close button
The sheet's controls (chips, options, one field group, or actions)
One primary action at the foot of the sheet
optional: A ghost Reset or Cancel on the left of the head
A count on the primary button ("Show 24 places")
A detent: half height for quick choices, large for a longer task

primaryAction.note: The last thing in the sheet, full width (od-actions or od-btn--block), naming the result: "Show 24 places", "Add expense".

avoid: A tab bar or a header over the scrim
A screen taller than the phone, or a sheet with nothing behind it
More than one filled button in the sheet
A hero, a big figure or a photo in the sheet

variants.layout: Filter sheet at a medium or large detent: Reset left, title, close right; groups of chips, a segmented sort and a switch row, each under a small label; Apply naming the result count at the foot.

Share or action sheet: the item it is about as one row on top, a row of 4 share targets (icon over a word), then 2–3 action rows with a destructive one last in red text; for a bare choice, an action sheet with Cancel alone in the last card.
Quick-add sheet, content-high: title and close, one large value or one field group in an od-form, a row of chips for the category, then the one primary button.
Side drawer from the left over the scrim: profile head (avatar, name, plan), the app's destinations as rows with the current one tinted, a small label over a second group, settings in the footer.
